findings.title: Separate indexed menu outcomes from Record-content support
findings.head: 599515a1cc149872229d0e4d309c39989536fef1
findings.reason: The algebra sums indexed effect families, but the note identifies those families with the support of a probability measure on unindexed matrix possibilities. Equal effects can recur: the actual L_CONT output at orthogonal directions is (I/2,I/2), whose set support is a singleton. Using the declared per-effect Born grade on that support gives total 1/2. Actual L_A at c=1/2 and L_4 at (1/4,1/2) give collapsed masses 3/4 and 7/8. Thus the normalized indexed construction is not the stated support-faithful local Record law. Covariance checks using sets also erase multiplicities.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep the useful indexed-effect mathematics, explicitly supply indexed outcome semantics, and distinguish the pushforward Record-content distribution p(E)=sum_{j:E_j=E}q_j from the per-index grade. Equal content does not encode an outcome label. Explain that pushforward masses generally depend on multiplicity/menu and do not automatically satisfy the stated cross-condition effect-grade clause. Physical/index registration and formation remain open. Add actual duplicate-effect and multiplicity-aware covariance controls; do not silently delete duplicate outcomes or retune weights to preserve a false claim.

findings.title: Narrow the universal scale-reading and minimal-price claims
findings.head: 599515a1cc149872229d0e4d309c39989536fef1
findings.reason: The law-specific branch exclusion is correct, but scale blindness does not forbid collinear menus. A unique repeated direction m plus a spectator n supplies a=(1+m.n)/2 without reading record scales. The majority-direction rule returns (aP(m),(1-a)P(m),P(-m)), is permutation invariant and covariant, and leaves every other L_CONT branch untouched. With m=(1,0,0), n=(-3/5,4/5,0), the exact menu is (P(m)/5,4P(m)/5,P(-m)); all 24 proper cubic rotations and all record permutations pass. The parameter varies continuously across the full collinear family. No order/minimization criterion proves a smallest covariant repair. A directed class and a nonzero supplied tilt are also not necessary for Born form: the maximally mixed grade is already a counterexample to that blanket price wording.
findings.minimal_fix: Restrict exclusion to the three declared laws and describe M1/M2/M3 as chosen branch modifications. Preserve the direction-only alternative as an explicit counterexample to the broader no-go. Limit directed-class/tilt requirements to the goal of a non-maximally-mixed directional state. Remove universal necessity/minimality from scope, corollary, explanatory prose and output labels, while retaining all actual finite counts and covariance results.

findings.title: State raw and conditional sign probabilities separately
findings.head: 599515a1cc149872229d0e4d309c39989536fef1
findings.reason: For the mixed menu (cP(m),cP(-m),(1-c)I), the +m effect sum is cP(m), not P(m). At c=1/2 and rho=I/2 the raw odds are 1/4,1/4,1/2. S3 divides the positive directional weight by c, then prints a lemma claiming the unconditional positive weight equals tr(rho P(m)). The existing S2b row already contradicts that printed lemma. A scalar-identity outcome has no direction under the supplied R1 reading.
findings.minimal_fix: Give raw probabilities c p, c(1-p), 1-c and conditional directional probability p. Restrict the unconditional sign lemma to the rank-one collinear refinements; explicitly condition the mixed case on a directional outcome. Distinguish recording a random sign from forcing a definite sign; a collinear menu does carry a sign even though splitting it does not remove its uncertainty. Fix all dependent narrative/claim/cache labels and add actual raw-versus-conditional controls.

findings.title: Expose the joint-resampling assumption and preserve Record permanence
findings.head: 599515a1cc149872229d0e4d309c39989536fef1
findings.reason: One-site fair odds and local neighbor conditioning do not specify a product distribution for a whole class. The runner raises 1/2 or 5/6 to N squared; it does not derive a joint formation law. A uniform even-parity distribution on eight bits has every bit conditional on any six others exactly fair but assigns all-zero probability 1/128 rather than 1/256. The parent repeats the same multiplication without the missing joint premise. Re-registering existing sites also needs an auxiliary resampling interpretation because the current Record memo makes records permanent.
findings.minimal_fix: Retain the powers as exact arithmetic under an explicitly supplied independent, one-shot auxiliary resampling/readout protocol (or provide a valid joint construction, which is additional work). Do not identify overwriting fixed records with an axiom-native formation event. Preserve the correlated counterexample and separate one-site odds, joint law, deterministic flip-pattern probe and sequential formation. No claim about stochastic typical winding survival follows from one deterministic pattern.

findings.title: Certify the whole spectral window or label the count as sampled
findings.head: 599515a1cc149872229d0e4d309c39989536fef1
findings.reason: The solver takes the 60 eigenvalues nearest zero and filters them by |E|<0.686. For the actual 1/2 flip pattern, the full 1152-dimensional spectrum has 68 states in that window; the original solver omits eight, its 60th absolute energy being 0.64408. A claimed complete absence of core states therefore does not follow from that calculation alone. Independent dense diagonalization does confirm zero core states for this exact matrix (the omitted states have core weight at most 0.122895). The unflipped control has 16 window states and two core states. This is a missing coverage check, not a counterexample to the reported exact-pattern count.
findings.minimal_fix: Use a complete bounded eigensystem for this small fixed matrix, or verify that the extracted spectrum encloses the whole window and fail closed otherwise. Alternatively retain an explicitly sampled-60 count. Keep the finite matrix, window, core threshold, deterministic pattern and basis-sensitive individual-vector criterion explicit; do not promote this to a general random-sign or infinite-volume theorem.

findings.title: Return failure when a scientific check fails
findings.head: 599515a1cc149872229d0e4d309c39989536fef1
findings.reason: The check function increments FAIL, and the terminal line only prints the counters. The exact extracted counter plus final printer runs a false predicate, prints FAIL=1 and exits 0. The actual current cache API classifies usable output by execution status/exit code, not that counter. The full original run happened to pass; its success does not repair the failure path.
findings.minimal_fix: After printing the complete diagnostic summary, return nonzero if FAIL is nonzero. Add an actual false-predicate terminal/control path and confirm the real cache consumer rejects its nonzero execution, preserving the failure artifact. This need not repeat the expensive census for each mutation.

findings.title: Bind the external continuum proof and copied-source provenance
findings.head: 599515a1cc149872229d0e4d309c39989536fef1
findings.reason: The general conclusions consume #7950 Lemmas 1/2 and its all-mode argument; finite j/24, k<=12 and 52-direction ranks do not replace them. That source is absent from the current-main overlay and is referred to only by an open PR number, without an immutable proof excerpt or exact source identity in the note. The runner also says four b7/h3 probe scripts are landed, but none is in the complete original three-path delta. Its claim that the copied float block is verbatim is false literally: the open-plane specialization removes a periodic branch/return values and an unused method, and renames locals. The inspected used numerical operations agree in the executed open-plane branch.
findings.minimal_fix: Provide precise immutable proof-source identities and bounded lemma excerpts or a self-contained proof appendix for the actual great-circle/gluing and all-mode reductions. Make the continuum steps explicit, including the scalar-mode elimination before oddness and the all-k argument, while preserving the finite certificates as finite evidence. Correct the probe/copy provenance to the actual original source and explain the open-plane specialization. Keep the remainder of #7919/#7926/#7931/#7950/#7969/#7973 and their ancestors conditional/unaccepted; do not import their full campaigns or enroll them as active proof nodes just to satisfy a pathname.
